transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... I just can't keep my mind on one thing anymore. At work, mostly. I'll be in the middle of fixing a rendering bug, and... I don't know, a Slack ping, or a certain color pattern on the screen, or even just a siren outside... it just pulls me into a whole new idea. I end up moving on before I can even finish typing the line of code. So... yeah. That's what brought me in.
Are these distractions and shifts in focus causing you a lot of stress or problems at work?

Yeah... I suppose so. They actually... well, my employer put me on leave recently. I sort of bypassed the usual approval process and just deployed some changes on my own. 

And... it's not just work. My wife says things feel unstable at home right now. Just... arguing more, and she's upset about some spending lately. So... yeah. It's causing some issues.
Have you been acting on impulses without thinking them through, aside from the incident with deploying changes at work?

I guess... yeah. The spending my wife mentioned... I bought some things for a project. We hadn't talked about it, but... I just needed them right then. Some GPUs, materials for printing, videos for promotion... 

And the work thing... I just couldn't wait for another review cycle. If I waited, the whole opportunity was going to die. So I just... pushed the update. It didn't feel like an impulse at the time. It just felt like what had to be done.
Have you often acted on impulses in your personal relationships, outside of work and spending?
No... I don't think so. I mean, we've just been arguing more, like I said. But... no, I haven't done anything else.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're sitting still?

I wouldn't call it fidgety. It's just... sitting still feels like I'm wasting the moment. 

There's just this constant current right now. I wake up and I'm already planning things out in my head... code changes, new features... even exhibition layouts and press angles for the project. So... yeah, I don't really want to just sit there when there's so much to do.
How long have you been feeling this way, with all these distractions and impulses?
I guess... about three months. Ever since they told me my platform was picked for the Glendale showcase. That's when everything started.
Are you feeling like your relationships with friends and family are being negatively impacted by your current behavior and thoughts?

I suppose... she thinks so. My wife, I mean. She says things feel unstable at home lately. Mostly because of the arguments, and... the money I've been spending. 

And, well... it's not just her. My employer actually put me on administrative leave. I didn't want to wait for the approval process, so I just deployed some code changes on my own. So... yeah. I guess people are reacting to what I'm doing.
Do you feel like your current way of thinking and behaving is causing you significant distress?

Distress? I don't know if I'd call it distress. I mean... I guess it's causing problems. 

Like I said, work put me on leave because of the code deployment. They didn't like that I skipped the approval process. And... my wife is upset. She says the arguments and the money I put into the project are making things unstable at home. So... it's stressful for them, I suppose.
Do you feel like your current way of thinking and behaving is causing you significant personal distress?
No. I mean... I feel fine. Like I just said, it's everyone else who seems to have a problem with it right now. I wouldn't say I'm personally distressed, no. I'm just trying to get my project done.
Are you experiencing these distractions and impulses at home or when you're not working on your project, or are they mainly happening when you're working or thinking about your project?
I don't really know. I haven't paid that much attention to it. I guess it's mostly when I'm working, but... it's hard to separate it all out. I'm just always kind of thinking about it.
Do you find yourself getting distracted and shifting focus when you're doing things that have nothing to do with your project?

I guess... yeah. That's actually kind of what brought me in, I suppose. I just... I can't keep my mind on one thing anymore. 

Like, I'll be in the middle of fixing a rendering bug, and... a Slack ping goes off, or I notice a color pattern somewhere, or even just hear a siren outside. It just pulls me into a whole new idea. I won't even have finished the line of code yet and I'm already on to something else. So... yeah. It shifts a lot.
Are you experiencing these distractions and shifts in focus when you're doing leisure activities or relaxing, such as watching TV or reading a book?
I don't really know... I haven't been watching TV or reading. I'm just working. There isn't time for that other stuff right now.
Do you experience these distractions and shifts in focus when you're under a lot of pressure or stress, versus when things are more calm and relaxed?
I don't really know. Like I said, I'm just always working. It's... it's all just kind of the same right now.
Have you experienced significant symptoms of inattention or hyperactivity-impulsivity prior to the past three months?
I... no. I don't think so. I was fine before all this started.
Have you experienced any significant symptoms of anxiety or depression lately?
I don't... no. Not really. I'm just focused on my work. That's all.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you didn't experience any of these symptoms?
I mean... most of my life. Like I just said, I was fine before a few months ago. I didn't have any issues before this.
Have you experienced any significant manic or hypomanic episodes in the past?
I don't really know what you mean by that... but no. I haven't had any episodes. Like I keep saying, everything was fine before.
Have you ever experienced a period of abnormally elevated or irritable mood that lasted for several days?

I wouldn't call it... abnormal. But, yeah, lately I've felt pretty... energized, I guess. Like I'm finally firing on all cylinders. Everything I've been working on, it's just clicking, like the city is finally ready for it. But... I don't know, I do get annoyed. My wife, the people at work... they keep dragging their feet, talking about "process" and slowing me down. I might snap at them sometimes. But I'm just trying to get things done.
Have you experienced a period of time where you felt abnormally energetic or irritable and didn't need much sleep?

I haven't really noticed. I mean... I sleep when I'm tired. I don't really keep track of the hours or anything. I'm just busy with work right now, so... I sleep when I can. It doesn't feel abnormal to me.
Have you experienced a period of time where you felt abnormally energetic and didn't need much sleep, and also felt unusually happy or irritable at the same time?

I feel like you're just asking me the same thing again. I... I don't really know what else to tell you. Like I just said, I'm focused on my work and I sleep when I need to. I don't sit around tracking all these feelings at the same time. I'm just doing what I need to do.
